name: App Launch Video With Voice
description: Turn a verified product brief into an idea-to-app-builder video project, narrate every clip with Edge TTS, and render the finished MP4.

config.topic: Forge, an AI app builder that turns an idea into a working product
config.audience: Solo founders and small product teams who can describe a product but cannot ship one alone
config.objective: Convince the viewer that a described idea can become a real, deployable product in one session
config.centralThesis: Building was the bottleneck; describing the product is now enough to ship one.
config.sourceNotes:
Replace these placeholders with your own verified evidence before running.
Product documentation: https://example.com/forge/docs
Launch announcement: https://example.com/forge/launch
config.factualBoundaries: Only describe capabilities documented in the linked sources. No pricing, customer names, benchmarks, or availability dates.
config.requiredPoints:
Ideas outnumber shipped products.
Building used to require a team.
The builder produces a real application with auth and a database.
Changes are made by describing them.
config.forbiddenClaims:
No claims of being the best or fastest tool.
No invented user counts, revenue, or funding.
No comparisons to named competitors.

config.systemPrompt: You are a storyboard director for a local motion-graphics video renderer. You return one JSON document and nothing else: no Markdown fences, no commentary. Every claim in the narration must be supported by the upstream brief.
